gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same erroneous fixed-R convergence claim. It explicitly states that mesh refinement sends the upper endpoint only to the finite-radius Dirichlet eigenvalue, sends the lower endpoint to the finite-radius Neumann expression with its correction factor, and that convergence to the whole-space eigenvalue additionally requires R to tend to infinity.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the false inference that h_max tending to zero alone removes finite-radius truncation and the lower-bound exterior correction, thereby yielding exact whole-space eigenvalues. The prediction also supplies the corrected fixed-R limits and the required additional R-to-infinity condition.

component_coverage.gold_component: The asserted fixed-domain mesh-refinement limit is incorrectly identified with the whole-space eigenvalue: the upper endpoint retains the finite-radius Dirichlet truncation, the lower endpoint retains its finite-radius Neumann/exterior correction, and exact whole-space convergence requires R to infinity as well.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction independently diagnoses every substantive aspect of the gold concern: it gives the two incorrect fixed-R limits, identifies the positive truncation and correction residuals, states that the enclosure width does not vanish at fixed R, and specifies that R must also tend to infinity.
